text:
monica: Heads-up — noticed a customer report where a resumed streaming session caused a truncated tool call and they got charged twice for the tail tokens.

devon: ugh. any repro or traces?

monica: repro on stage. routing did a region-fallback when the primary node dropped, the client reconnected and we resumed, but the downstream toolcall ended up split into two executions. logs:```
[INFO] 2026-03-19T14:02:12Z session resume id=sr-83 route=us-west-2->eu-central toolcall_id=tc-9 status=ok tokens=124
[INFO] 2026-03-19T14:02:12Z tool-exec id=tc-9-part1 status=ok tokens=78
[WARN] 2026-03-19T14:02:12Z truncation during handoff suffix_mismatch=true
[INFO] 2026-03-19T14:02:13Z tool-exec id=tc-9-part2 status=ok tokens=46
```

alex: so two executions with distinct toolcall ids, but same parent session. billing ledger saw both and credited full tokens for each?

monica: yep. provisional logic currently credits every committed tool-exec. when we do resume/handoff we sometimes create new ephemeral toolcall ids instead of appending — ledger doesn't dedupe across resume boundaries.

devon: is the split deterministic? looks like part1 is before truncation and part2 after resume. is there overlap (double counted tokens identical) or just continuation counted twice?

monica: overcount occurs when the suffix overlap detection fails. if part2 includes the last chunk of part1 again — double-charge. sometimes it's an off-by-one in our prefix capture.

alex: this smells like routing policy + prefetch. The prefetch sidecar caches KV and we replay on fallback. Two things to fix: 1) prefer idempotent toolcall ids across handoff, 2) ledger-level soft-dedupe for contiguous toolcall siblings within same session/resume window.

tara: agree. UX-wise the console should show "provisional resume duplicates" and let ops mark them for manual consolidation while we push dedupe heuristics. Customers will freak if they see double bills.

monica: proposed quick mitigation: when a resume occurs, propagate previous toolcall parent id into the new execution metadata (resume_parent=tc-9). Then ledger can attribute tokencount to parent if timespan overlap < grace_window.

devon: what's a safe grace_window? our traces show handoffs take 200–1200ms. set to 2s? but careful about long-poll clients that legitimately retry.

alex: maybe metric-driven: if tool-exec part2 start_ts - part1.end_ts < 3s and input_prefix_similarity > 0.9 then treat as continuation. We already emit input hashes in traces.

monica: adding input hash on the toolcall metadata should be doable this sprint. will also need a console flag to surface these events in the Token Accounting dashboard.

devon: ledger change: add a provisional dedupe pass for resume_parent, score, and time delta. Deduped charges should be marked provisional until a periodic reconciliation job confirms. also need to emit a reconciliation event so billing pipeline can roll back if needed.

alex: re: rollouts — feature flag gated. fallback to old behavior if anything goes wrong. Also add an alert when provisional dedupe rate > 0.1% to catch false positives.

tara: for product: console should show a per-session trace view showing resume arrows, toolcall fragments, and an explicit "dedupe suggestion" with link to audit event. Ops should be able to accept/reject.

monica: small config snippet for proposed metadata change:```json
{"toolcall_id": "tc-9", "resume_parent": "tc-9", "input_hash": "sha256:abc123", "resume_seq": 1}
```

devon: test plan: 1) synthetic resume with identical prefix -> ensure dedupe triggers 2) resume with intentional overlap -> ensure dedupe not too aggressive 3) long retry loops -> ensure we don't suppress legitimate multiple toolcalls

alex: can we add an observability dashboard tile: "resume-induced provisional dedupe rate" and "average resume delta"? Also sample traces to S3 for manual inspection.

monica: yep. I'll own the patch for trace metadata + small ledger rule. devon can own reconciliation job. alex — dashboard + console UX. tara — product + support messaging.

sre-bot: deploy-status: canary rollout queued for tag=resume-dedupe-v1.0.0 to 10% traffic in us-west-2 at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z :rocket:

tara: timeline? customer-facing note needed?

monica: aiming canary tomorrow, wide rollout after 48h if no anomalies. We'll draft an internal KB and a short customer note explaining short-term provisional credits for disputed invoices.

devon: leaving a TODO: add unit tests for input_hash collision (tiny probability) and ensure we don't dedupe across different user IDs even if content matches.

alex: sounds good. patch review when ready. thx all :thumbsup:
